subject: ela
cluster: Research to build and present knowledge

items.prompt:
Using a source's exact words in quotation marks is:
A) quoting
B) paraphrasing
C) summarizing

steps: Word for word. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Restating an idea in your own words is:
A) paraphrasing
B) quoting
C) copying

When you paraphrase a source, you:
A) still must cite it
B) never cite it
C) can claim it as yours

Assessing a source's CREDIBILITY means checking:
A) whether it is trustworthy and accurate
B) its font
C) its color
items.answer: A) whether it is trustworthy and accurate

solution.answer: A) whether it is trustworthy and accurate

items.prompt:
Which search terms are MOST effective for finding how vaccines work?
A) 'how vaccines work immune system'
B) 'stuff'
C) 'cool science'

A good paraphrase:
A) keeps the original meaning in your own words
B) copies the exact words
C) changes the meaning
items.answer: A) keeps the original meaning in your own words

steps: Own words, same idea. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) keeps the original meaning in your own words

items.prompt:
A student copies three sentences from a website word-for-word with no quotation marks or citation. This is:
A) plagiarism
B) correct paraphrasing
C) proper quoting

steps: No credit or marks. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Which source is MOST credible for a report on climate?
A) a peer-reviewed study from a scientific organization
B) an anonymous social media post
C) a joke website
items.answer: A) a peer-reviewed study from a scientific organization

solution.answer: A) a peer-reviewed study from a scientific organization
